subject.description: The heading of the 目 column, the first of the left page.

budget.description: The heading of the labelled budget column (予算額).

explanation.description: The heading of the right page's one column (説明).

summary.description: The headings of the summary's three columns (款・項・金額).

budget_labels.description: A label of a line of the budget cell and the shared-dictionary heading of its amount (`本年度`: 本年度予算額).

rate_line.description: The label of the budget cell's rate line (増減率(%)): read, not taken in, as a coverage exclusion.

summary_amount.description: The heading of the summary's amount and of the budget label it repeats (本年度予算額).

setsu_amount.description: The heading of the 節 amount in the shared dictionary.

explanation_amount.description: The heading of an explanation item's amount in the shared dictionary.

markers.description: The explanation item markers, one pattern per depth from the top (a whole word: `1`, `(1)`).

marker_reach.description: How far right of the explanation frame's left edge an item marker may start.

item_amount_reach.description: An item's amount ends within this distance of the explanation frame's right edge.

total_label.description: The label of the 項 total cell in the 目 column.

grand_total_label.description: The label of the summary's total row (歳出合計).
